descriptionHtml:
Bug B18 · P1 · known

Many dates and times follow the device clock instead of server time (UAT 3.8): 'NEW TODAY', admit date, vitals date, task done time, transcript date; with a phone two days slow a held drug is stamped two days back and the next cleanup deletes it

Tickets: TFA-92584 ready for qa (UAT 3.8) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Root cause known (Daniela asked for server time on 10-03); the deleted drug, missing badge and wrong draft restore are new symptoms

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S25

Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S08 Web browser with the wrong date and time zone shows the same day/visit number, badge, 'New today' and DOB age

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 The day/visit number advances each calendar day by server time and never stays frozen; a device with a wrong clock or time zone shows the same number. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 4; UAT 3.8)
  • U4 The card shows the New Admission / Follow-up / Consult badge. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U3 The card shows age/sex in the "76F" format. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Same account and seededCensus in two Playwright browser contexts: A normal; B with timezoneId 'Pacific/Honolulu' and page.clock.setSystemTime(server now + 1 d)

When Open the Hospital list and both Nursing Home lists in A and in B

Then For every card the day/visit number, the badge and the presence of 'New today' are identical in A and B; N6 (87th birthday today by server date) shows 87 and N7 (birthday tomorrow) shows 86 in both contexts

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.8: identical state on both clocks; per card, compare A and B (card-scoped locators 'Open chart for <name>'). knownGaps: the badge mismatch only, 'TFA-92584 AC 8' (main computes the badge with localDay()). A day/visit number or 'New today' mismatch (main's 'New today' uses new Date()) reports against TFA-92579 AC 3/4. DOB rows: 87 / 86 in both contexts under Q12; …

Where it ran: local newspec-a (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92579 ready for qa; TFA-92584 ready for qa

On a computer whose clock or time zone is a day off, a patient added today does not get the 'NEW TODAY' tag that every other device shows, and opening the list on that computer also flips New Admission and Consult badges to Follow-up for every device.

Evidence: newspec-a (final2 run). Browsers B (Honolulu, +1 d) and B2 (UTC, +1 d) both lose 'NEW TODAY' on H3/HX, because PatientCard compares addedAt with the device date. This was only predicted in the TC-01 risks; it is not in the dev report or ledger, and the matrix sends it to TFA-92579 AC 3/4 as not known. The badge roll is known (TFA-92584 AC 8, device-clock localDay). DOB ages are recorded only (Q12). Day/visit numbers are missing in every context (see S06/S26).

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-a.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-a.

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S08

Web browser with the wrong date and time zone shows the same day/visit number, badge, 'New today' and DOB age

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-a: status failed in newspec-a/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (newspec-a/plan.json, automatable: yes): Same seeded census, one account, two browser contexts: A normal; B with timezoneId Pacific/Honolulu and page.clock.setSystemTime(server now + 1 d). Read every card in A, then B, then A again (B's applyLifecycle runs with B's day). Compare per card: day/visit number, badge, 'New today'; N6/N7 ages 87/86. B and B2 (UTC, +1 d) sign in through the product form on the wrong-clock browser; the spec waits for the post-sign-in redirect before any page.goto and clears earlier tc01-s08-* evidence so all cited files come from one run. — Playwright contexts with timezoneId and page.clock on the local stack.

Detail:

One run (final2, 07:26:40-07:28:08Z; every cited file written by it): same account, normal browser A vs wrong-clock browsers signed in through the form on that browser: B (Pacific/Honolulu, server+1 d; device day = server day at this run's hour) and B2 (UTC, server+1 d). 'NEW TODAY' on H3 and HX (added today by the server's day) shows in A and is missing in B and B2. Day/visit numbers: absent in every context (judged in S26/S06). Badge (known TFA-92584 AC 8): B2 shows Follow-up for H1/N1 (New Admission) and H2/N3 (Consult), and after B2 opened the list the NORMAL browser also showed Follow-up - B2's applyLifecycle wrote the roll to the server with its own day. DOB rows (record-only, Q12): N6 'DOB Oct 14, 1939' and N7 'DOB Oct 15, 1939' show no age in any context. Test fixed: it waits for the post-sign-in redirect before navigating (an earlier final run failed on 'page.goto: net::ERR_ABORTED at /rounding'), has a 5 min timeout (took 1.5 min), and clears earlier tc01-s08-* files first.

Product issue: On a computer whose clock or time zone is off (here Hawaii time a day ahead, or UTC a day ahead), a patient added today does not get the 'NEW TODAY' tag that every other device shows, because PatientCard compares addedAt with the device's own date. Breaks UAT 3.8 ('A phone with a wrong clock, no clock set, or a different time zone shows the same state as any other device') and TFA-92579 AC 3/4. Known and worse: such a device also rolls New Admission / Consult to Follow-up on the server for every device (TFA-92584 AC 8).

Evidence: 8 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): two Playwright contexts on a seeded fresh account, seeded through the local admin helpers; dev has no admin key and one shared account, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
